title: Each step's tooltip renders as an ARIA APG dialog-modal with focus lifecycle and focus not obscured
iWant: each step's tooltip to behave like a proper dialog, with focus arriving on open and returning to the anchor on close and remaining visible at every breakpoint
soThat: an assistive-technology user hears the step content on open and returns to context on close, and no tooltip is clipped at the viewport edge

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a step showing a tooltip anchored to a UI element, focus moves to the tooltip on open; the tooltip carries role="dialog" with aria-labelledby pointing at the step heading; focus returns to the anchor on close (Escape or the dismiss control) per the ARIA APG dialog-modal pattern; focus is not obscured on the 1440 wide breakpoint or the 360 narrow breakpoint (WCAG 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured Minimum). Anchors to TAC-2701-application-onboarding-tour-step-runner; probed by application-onboarding-tour.pack.mjs check AC-26102-1.
The tooltip carries role="dialog", aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby resolving to the step heading id (WCAG 1.3.1 and 4.1.2 via the ARIA APG dialog-modal pattern verified today).
acceptanceCriteria.then: the tooltip element carries role="dialog", aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby resolving to a heading id present in the tooltip

acceptanceCriteria.description: Focus is trapped between the tour controls (previous, next, dismiss) while the dialog is open; Tab from the last control returns to the first, Shift+Tab from the first goes to the last, and Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to the anchor.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the keyboard walks Tab / Shift+Tab / Escape
acceptanceCriteria.then: focus stays within the tour controls until Escape or dismiss fires, then returns to the anchor
